financial.handoff: Financial owns money; Health consumes scoped results.
financial.input_requirement: Natural-grain nonoverlapping money rows with project, currency, book, period, basis, kind, approval/posting evidence.
financial.title: Approved budget and actual results

financial.handoff: Financial; Operations handles permitted follow-ups, analysis does not itself authorize financial execution.
financial.input_requirement: Actual charge/project links, eligibility, documented rule/trigger, hold state, invoice links and aging clock.
financial.title: Billing eligibility and holds

financial.handoff: Financial owns attribution; analysis does not itself authorize payment execution.
financial.input_requirement: Verified project → invoice → application links; as-of balance history; separate deposit, application, credit and unapplied kinds.
financial.title: Cash applications and aging

financial.handoff: Financial analysis; a purchasing transaction requires a separately authorized supported procedure.
financial.input_requirement: Verified order/receipt/bill/project links and separate approved/received/posted measures.
financial.title: Commitments and realized cost

financial.input_requirement: Recognition entries and linked source detail with matching currency/book/period/basis.
financial.title: Revenue reconciliation

financial.handoff: Financial owns compliance; Operations may supply factual approval queues.
financial.input_requirement: Effective policy version/scope plus full applicable employee/day or report population and native evaluation where returned.
financial.title: Expense-policy evidence

financial.handoff: Financial validates; Operations owns the plan lifecycle and approved operational subset.
financial.input_requirement: Versioned SOW plan/components and sow_tools.commercial_review output.
financial.title: SOW commercial mapping

operations.handoff: Operations; Risk for exposure classification; no rendering control performs an action.
operations.input_requirement: queues with queue_kind, exact entity type/reference, routing_verified, due/priority evidence; tasks and assignment data.
operations.title: Work queues

operations.handoff: Operations uses the inherited capacity helper; Risk supplies native staffing evidence.
operations.input_requirement: capacity_input uses capacity_tools.daily_ledger: complete resource directory, validated dated plannedwork, net calendar/leave rows, supported start/end.
operations.title: Daily work and capacity

operations.handoff: Operations; expense compliance and commercial effects stay with Financial.
operations.input_requirement: queues filtered to exact verified current routing, entity type/reference and record identity; deadline/SLA if available.
operations.title: Exact-user routed approvals

operations.handoff: Operations identifies facts; Risk interprets staffing exposure after native -9 intake.
operations.input_requirement: tasks + separate assignment rows + complete verified resources, assignment coverage/remaining-work detail when available.
operations.title: Staffing exceptions

operations.handoff: Operations; Financial validates comparable prices only when relevant.
operations.input_requirement: candidate_request + dated daily ledger + exact role ID and dated requirements; explicit price criteria only when requested.
operations.title: Employee role/capacity comparison

operations.handoff: Operations coordinates proposal and any separately approved action workflow.
operations.input_requirement: Validated daily ledger and unique placement_id/resource/date/hours plus verified role match and eligibility.
operations.title: Proposed placement scenario

operations-sow.handoff: Operations owns; Financial validates terms; Risk performs plan-risk review; Health assesses existing portfolio impact.
operations-sow.input_requirement: SOW-1.0 plan; sources, obligations, actions, commercial components, decisions and confirmed edits.
operations-sow.title: Seven-section SOW plan

operations-sow.handoff: Operations controls revisions; specialist owners revalidate affected portions.
operations-sow.input_requirement: prior_plan and current plan validated by sow_tools.diff; revision log and field_evidence.
operations-sow.title: Source / prior / current differences

operations-sow.handoff: Operations execution workflow only; UI Explain/Compare never writes.
operations-sow.input_requirement: Validated plan, actual approval evidence and optional runtime preflight; display the existing SOW gate result separately.
operations-sow.title: Exact approved-action preview

operations-sow.handoff: Operations; Financial and Risk review post-action evidence under unchanged scope.
operations-sow.title: Run and full reconciliation

portfolio-health.handoff: Health owns synthesis; Risk supplies classifications; Operations and Financial supply scoped facts.
portfolio-health.input_requirement: projects + classified risk_findings + tasks; frozen request/result and full risk review.
portfolio-health.title: Portfolio attention

portfolio-health.handoff: Health; request scheduling facts from Operations without recursively restarting the root review.
portfolio-health.input_requirement: recorded_dates: label, baseline_date, current_date, baseline_version, dates_verified, source_refs.
portfolio-health.title: Recorded delivery dates

portfolio-health.handoff: Health for recorded milestones; Risk for supported acceptance exposure.
portfolio-health.input_requirement: milestones: explicit milestone identity, dates, completion and acceptance requirements/state with acceptance_verified.
portfolio-health.title: Milestones and acceptance

portfolio-health.handoff: Health owns the comparison; supporting owners revalidate changed facts.
portfolio-health.input_requirement: changes.previous/current: identical account, project_ids, role fingerprint, source-definition fingerprint and window basis; findings with stable keys and source refs.
portfolio-health.title: Matched-snapshot changes

portfolio-health.handoff: Health presents; Risk owns supported exposure; Operations owns permitted link changes.
portfolio-health.input_requirement: dependencies with edge_verified, predecessor, successor, dependency type, dates and source refs.
portfolio-health.title: Verified dependency detail

risk.handoff: Risk owns classification; Health coordinates combined requests; Operations/Financial supply facts.
risk.input_requirement: Risk-classified findings, full root risk/request ledgers, all native intake and supporting sources.
risk.title: Supported exposure overview

risk.handoff: Risk; staffing investigation prioritizes native coverage -9 before ordinary capacity.
risk.input_requirement: native_input for indicator_tools.select_results; include discovered types, all statuses, historical cutoff and missing transport state.
risk.title: Native Indicator results

risk.handoff: Risk owns exposure; Health/Operations supply task evidence.
risk.input_requirement: Normalized distinct incomplete executable leaves, verified effective end/FNLT semantics, aware cutoff/timezone.
risk.title: Overdue work aging

risk.handoff: Operations supplies staffing facts; Risk classifies supported exposure.
risk.input_requirement: Verified task/assignment/resource identities and native coverage detail.
risk.title: Assignment gap detail

risk.handoff: Risk owns applicability, candidate resolution and scoped search completion.
risk.input_requirement: Frozen investigation plan, completed source/search partitions and terminal candidate inventory.
risk.title: Investigation search coverage

risk.handoff: Risk explains exposure; Financial alone supplies monetary variants.
risk.input_requirement: Compatible independently supported conditions with verified shared project/task links.
risk.title: Supported combined exceptions

risk.handoff: Risk groups findings; Health owns portfolio synthesis.
risk.input_requirement: Explicit verified project/customer links and classified findings.
risk.title: Client grouping
